text:
Asha: Hey team — renewal check for Northridge next week, signal looks weak. Want a super short customer-facing checklist we can share in the call + a tiny ops runbook for enablement/eng if we see latency spikes. Anyone got a lean version?
Liam: +1. Can we keep the customer checklist <= 6 bullets? Make it actionable (what to try, what we'll do).
Priya: I can draft. Quick Q — they use streaming heavily and do occasional batch bulk scoring for reports.
Asha: correct, streaming chat for support, nightly batch for reports. Renewal risk because of some latency spikes last month.
Marta: For customer: 1) Confirm region & dedicated capacity preference 2) Turn on simple TTL-based response cache for repeated prompts 3) Use short streaming timeouts before fallback to sync call 4) Schedule a 15m perf triage with us (we'll bring ops) 5) Share 3 example prompts (high-value) 6) Opt into 48h warm-up (we pre-start a warm pool)
Asha: love that. Make wording customer-facing: no ops jargon.
Priya: Draft customer-friendly bullets: 
- Quick check: are you on the us-west region? (we can move you faster)
- Try a 30s stream timeout in the client — we'll auto-fallback to a fast sync path if nothing returns
- Enable "repeat-response cache" for identical prompts (saves tokens & latency)
- Share 3 example queries before the call so we can test live
- Book a 15-min perf check — we'll pre-warm capacity
- We'll monitor and flag anything that looks like an error spike :eyes:
Liam: For the internal ops runbook (two-pager): short checklist items + commands. Keep it consumable by SEs.
Marta: Proposed internal steps: 1) Validate tenant routing (region/dedicated) 2) Increase warm-pool target to +2 for 48h 3) Enable edge-cache TTL=300s for repetitive prompts 4) Apply graceful-degradation policy: stream_timeout=30s -> fallback_model=smaller-llm 5) Turn on enhanced telemetry for the tenant for 72h (token-level latency histograms)
Priya: Add quick commands snippet for SEs: 
```
# bump warm pool
redwoodctl tenants set-warmpool --tenant northridge --delta 2 --duration 48h
# enable edge cache for tenant
redwoodctl tenants set-cache --tenant northridge --mode edge --ttl 300
# set fallback policy
redwoodctl tenants set-policy --tenant northridge --policy "stream_timeout=30s;fallback=fast-small"
```
Asha: Nice. Also include quick rollback steps if the change causes regressions.
Marta: rollback snippet: 
```
redwoodctl tenants set-warmpool --tenant northridge --absolute 0
redwoodctl tenants set-cache --tenant northridge --mode off
redwoodctl tenants set-policy --tenant northridge --policy "default"
```
Liam: Telemetry notes: add a short eval prompt set (3 prompts) to run every hour and post to the outreach channel if avg latency > 500ms.
Priya: I'll add the eval ping and a tiny feedback capture template for the CS rep to use on the call:
"On this call, did you notice delays? If yes, please copy one example prompt and approximate time."
Asha: Perfect. Can someone make this into a one-pager and drop in the customer success playbook before EOD?
CS Bot: New doc created: https://docs.redwood.ai/cs/runbooks/renewal-earlywarning-northridge (private) :white_check_mark:
Marta: Uploaded one-pager to the playbook section and linked the redwoodctl snippets.
Asha: Thanks all — I'll send the customer checklist ahead of the call and tag eng for the 15m perf slot. :pray:
Liam: If renewal talk goes sideways, we route to Dedicated offering; include cost/latency tradeoff note in the follow-up email.
Priya: I'll own the follow-up email template.
Asha: Closing — we have customer checklist, internal ops steps, snippets, rollback. Good to go.
